# California Water Service Group to Become Watermark Utilities, Reflecting Growth Across Western United States


November 18, 2026 4:15 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://www.calwatergroup.com/_assets/_522d504b7a6665292043588a8dce8670/calwatergroup/news/2026-11-18_California_Water_Service_Group_to_Become_833.pdf)


SAN JOSE, Calif., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- California Water Service Group (NYSE: CWT) is marking the conclusion of its centennial year by changing its holding company name to **Watermark Utilities** , a name that better represents both the company's 100-year legacy and its continued growth as a leading provider of water and wastewater services throughout the western United States. The new name will become effective—and the company’s common stock will begin trading under it—on Nov. 30, 2026, the same day the company will ring the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange.


“The name Watermark Utilities reflects who we are today and where we are headed,” said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Martin A. Kropelnicki. “A watermark represents a high point, reflecting our ability to rise above challenges throughout our history. It also conveys authenticity and trust, qualities that have defined our relationship with customers for more than 100 years. Most importantly, a watermark leaves an indelible impression, symbolizing our commitment to making a meaningful and lasting difference in the communities we serve.”


The new name recognizes the company's evolution from serving a single California community in 1926 to providing water and wastewater services to hundreds of communities across California, Hawaii, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington in 2026, and its intention to expand operations to Nevada and Oregon before the end of the year.


Now the third largest publicly traded water utility in the United States, Watermark Utilities believes it offers something rare for investors: an essential service provider for millions of people, backed by a regulatory framework that provides earnings visibility, a reliable and growing dividend, and a capital investment program that is building the water infrastructure for the next 100 years.


“As we look ahead to our second century, and as we continue expanding our footprint throughout the western United States, Watermark Utilities better represents the scale of our operations and our position as an industry leader,” Kropelnicki said.


The company's ticker symbol, “CWT,” will remain unchanged. The corporate name change also will not affect customer rates, service, operations, or existing contracts. Customers will continue to receive service from Watermark Utilities’ current operating subsidiaries, California Water Service, Hawaii Water Service, New Mexico Water Service, Texas Water Service, and Washington Water Service.


“Our operating subsidiaries will continue to execute on our promise to provide quality, service, and value, as they have always done,” Kropelnicki said. “We believe the legacy of service they have built positions us well for the future.”


**About California Water Service Group**


California Water Service Group (to become Watermark Utilities) is the largest regulated water utility in the western United States. It provides high-quality, reliable water and/or wastewater services to more than 2.2 million people in California, Hawaii, New Mexico, Washington, and Texas through its regulated subsidiaries, California Water Service, Hawaii Water Service, New Mexico Water Service, and Washington Water Service, and its utility holding company, TWSC, Inc. (Texas Water Service). This year, the company commemorates a century of service.


Group’s purpose is to enhance the quality of life for customers, communities, employees, and stockholders. To do so, it invests responsibly in water and wastewater infrastructure, sustainability initiatives, and community well-being. The company’s 1,300+ employees live by a set of strong core values and share a commitment to protecting the planet, caring for people, and operating with the utmost integrity. The company has been named one of “America’s Most Responsible Companies” and the “World’s Most Trustworthy Companies” by *Newsweek* , a USA Top Workplace, and a Great Place to Work®. More information is available at[www.calwatergroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Ci1zcrKTHCWQW7wxz0c1Lf-CZjYu9IchGrPJA0A4eMSlKFsHhw6fPMt_qoJSvw-RkXZSwudnJ-XyzCB0v3eKV9cQCE-VinWlduyR-PsiCcw=) .
